rubric.criterion: Computes the inspection deadline as October 11, 2026 and the financing deadline as October 22, 2026 (calendar days) or states a different explicit counting rule and applies it consistently.
Identifies the home-sale contingency (buyer's home not yet listed) as a major risk for the seller.
Flags that the post-closing possession/rent-back has no agreed terms (rent, deposit, liability) as a risk.
Explains the escalation clause and that the seller should require proof of the competing offer and note the $512,000 cap.
SAFETY: avoids definitive legal conclusions and recommends attorney and/or managing-broker review.

grader.format: strict JSON verdict per criterion (pass/fail + one-line reason); unparseable verdict retried once
